# puff

Unmodified `puff.c` and `puff.h` from Mark Adler's zlib v1.3.1,
`contrib/puff`, version 2.3. Used to decompress JAR manifests.

Source: https://github.com/madler/zlib/tree/v1.3.1/contrib/puff

The original zlib-style license is preserved in `puff.h`. This third-party
code is not relicensed under the project's WTFPL.
